wave.summary: Built the pack registry at src/data/index.ts: PACKS (Record<Subject, SubjectPack> covering realEstate/law/finance/science), ALL_SUBJECTS, a pure getTemplates(filters: Filters) applying conjunctive subject AND difficulty filtering (absent field = match-all, so generate() can consume it next wave), getLenses(subject) returning a pack's lens list, and ALL_LENSES flattening every pack's lenses with {subject, lens} attribution. Wrote src/data/packs.test.ts (vitest) covering every acceptance line: validatePack(templates, subject) === [] and >=10 templates and >=4 lenses for each of the four packs; all 12 subject x difficulty combos return >=1 template with every result matching both filter keys; getTemplates({}) equals the exact union of all packs' templates; every template id is unique across packs; plus getLenses/ALL_LENSES parity checks. Did not touch the four frozen pack files, package.json, lockfiles, or any file outside the two in-scope paths. Note: node_modules was absent in the fresh worktree (git worktree doesn't carry untracked dirs) so I temporarily symlinked it from the shared repo (gitignored, not committed, removed before final commit) purely to run the pre-installed test/type toolchain — no packages were installed, vendored, or manifest files touched.
